English: Herbalists Lean-to
A simple shelter of branches and hides, where basic herbs are gathered and applied for the most urgent wounds and sicknesses.
Simple Healers Tent
A humble tent where an apprentice healer tends wounds, using poultices and simple remedies to aid recovery.
Medicine Pouch Stand
A semi-permanent stand where healers keep dried roots, poultices, and medicinal pouches at the ready for the tribe.
Wound Care Pavilion
A large felt pavilion where skilled healers tend to the wounded, offering organized care and herbal treatments.
Shamans Shelter
A respected shamans tent, filled with charms and rare herbs, where both body and spirit are tended.
Remedy Storage Hut
A sturdy hut for storing herbs, ointments, and rare medicinal supplies, protected from weather and pests.
Healers Workshop
A specialized yurt where skilled practitioners prepare advanced medicines, salves, and even surgical tools.
Recovery Yurt
A grand yurt devoted to the convalescence of the tribes sick and wounded, well-equipped and staffed by seasoned healers.
Healing Compound
A cluster of yurts and workshops forming a full healing compound, with storage, preparation, and recovery areas for large numbers of wounded or sick.
River Nomad Infirmary
A renowned mobile hospital, famed across the river nomad lands, staffed by expert healers, shamans, and surgeons. The tribes sick and wounded recover here with unparalleled speed and care.
